title: Grindr Notification
blurb: Few message alerts arrive carrying this much implication. Grindr's notification is among the most instantly recognisable sounds any app has ever shipped, and the meme value comes entirely from context — played in a quiet public space, it turns heads, starts conversations and occasionally ends them. It has become a running joke in edits precisely because no explanation is ever required; the audience does all the work themselves. Use it for maximum insinuation in a video, or set it as your actual text tone and accept whatever follows. The sound speaks for itself, loudly.
